Project Laksa — Weekly Sync
Date: 3 June 2026
Present: Wei Ling (PM), Daniel (Eng), Priya (Design), Marcus (Ops)

Notes:
We reviewed the hawker-stall onboarding flow. Priya walked through the new menu-photo upload screen; feedback was positive but the empty state is confusing. Daniel flagged that the image API times out for files over 8MB and we have no client-side resize yet. Marcus raised that three stalls in the Maxwell pilot still have not received their QR table-tents, which is blocking their go-live.

Decisions:
- We will ship the photo-upload screen in the 12 June release, with a redesigned empty state.
- Client-side image resize is now a release blocker; it goes in before launch.
- The Maxwell pilot go-live moves from 10 June to 17 June to absorb the delay.

Action items:
- Priya to redesign the empty state and share mockups by 6 June.
- Daniel to add client-side resize (max 1600px) and retest the 8MB case by 10 June.
- Marcus to chase the printer on the QR table-tents and confirm delivery by 5 June.
- Wei Ling to update the launch comms once the new pilot date is locked.

Next sync: 10 June 2026, 4pm.

## Bonus B3 — Offline variant

An opt-in fallback to `B3-c-reference.workflow.json`. The **Fetch Doc (HTTP)** node is replaced by a **Load Mock Doc** Set node holding the contents of `sample-doc.txt`. Everything downstream is identical.

**When to use:** no Google account handy, no doc published yet, or you want a deterministic demo with no network. The lesson — get document text in, extract structure with an LLM — is unchanged; only the *source* of the text differs.

**To go live:** open `B3-c-reference.workflow.json`, publish a Google Doc, paste its ID, and the same extraction runs on real document text fetched over HTTP.
